summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3D coverflow carousel feature for 'Nuestras Categorías' section. All backend APIs, frontend desktop/mobile interactions, admin panel management, and regression checks passed successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/carousel-categories returns 15 items with product_count and auto-generated descriptions
Backend: Admin endpoints require authentication
Backend: Manual description save and auto-generation restore cycle
Desktop: Coverflow renders with 3D cards, rounded borders, sage green accent (#72A638)
Desktop: Caption displays number (NN/15), category name, product description, CTA button
Desktop: Prev/next navigation buttons update active category
Desktop: Auto-movement every ~2-3s without interaction
Desktop: Hover pauses auto-movement
Desktop: Click on center card navigates to /tienda?cat=... (with hover first to pause animation)
Desktop: CTA button 'Ver N productos' navigates to /tienda with category filter
Desktop: Horizontal drag moves carousel without triggering navigation
Mobile: Cards are exactly 210px width as expected
Mobile: Caption layout restacks correctly (2-column grid: 42px + content)
Mobile: Tap/click on center card navigates to /tienda with category filter
Mobile: Horizontal swipe moves carousel without scrolling page
Mobile: Navigation buttons work correctly
Admin: Description textarea present for each carousel item (data-testid carousel-description-N)
Admin: Manual description can be saved and appears in public endpoint
Admin: Clearing description restores auto-generated description with product list
Regression: No console errors on home page
Regression: Hero section intact
Regression: Featured products section intact
Regression: Recipes section intact
Regression: Footer intact
